versions.name: Ambition
versions.text: At the end of your 3rd, 7th, and 11th turns, add a Dream to the top of your deck.

versions.name: Ambition
versions.text: At the end of your 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th turns, add a Dream to the top of your deck.

versions.name: Ambition
versions.text: At the end of every 3 turns, add a Dream to the top of your deck.

versions.name: Ambition
versions.text: At the end of every 3 turns, add Dream to the top of your deck if you have no Dreams in hand or deck.
